This page is generated from the help text built into `chekin`, so it always matches the
code in the repository. Run `chekin <command> --help` to see the same text in your terminal.

Flags take one dash or two (`-o json` and `--o json` are the same) and go after the
command name. `reservations` works anywhere `bookings` does.

## `chekin`

```text
chekin: unofficial command line tool for Chekin (chekin.com)

Usage:
  chekin login [--email EMAIL] [--password-stdin]   log in with email and password
  chekin login --token JWT|-                        save a token copied from the browser
  chekin logout                                     forget the saved login
  chekin whoami                                     show the logged-in account
  chekin bookings list [flags]                      list bookings (alias: reservations)
  chekin bookings get ID [-o json]                  show one booking, with its guest links
  chekin version

Run "chekin <command> --help" for a command's flags.

Environment:
  CHEKIN_TOKEN                     token to use instead of the saved login
  CHEKIN_EMAIL, CHEKIN_PASSWORD    log in automatically when there is no valid token
  CHEKIN_API_URL                   API base URL (default https://a.chekin.io)
  CHEKIN_CONFIG_DIR                where the login is saved (default ~/.config/chekin)
```

## `chekin login`

```text
Usage: chekin login [--email EMAIL] [--password-stdin] | --token JWT|-

Flags:
  -email string
        account email (default $CHEKIN_EMAIL)
  -password-stdin
        read the password from stdin
  -token -
        save this token instead of logging in (- reads it from stdin)
```

## `chekin logout`

```text
Usage: chekin logout
```

No flags.

## `chekin whoami`

```text
Usage: chekin whoami
```

No flags.

## `chekin bookings list`

```text
Usage: chekin bookings list [flags]

Flags:
  -batch string
        batch number
  -checkout-from DATE
        check-out on or after DATE
  -checkout-to DATE
        check-out on or before DATE
  -desc
        newest check-in first (default oldest first)
  -external-id TEXT
        external booking ID contains TEXT
  -from DATE
        check-in on or after DATE (YYYY-MM-DD or today)
  -guest TEXT
        guest name contains TEXT
  -limit N
        return at most N bookings (0 = all)
  -links
        add guest check-in, payment and upsell links (one extra request per booking)
  -o string
        output format: table, json or jsonl (default "table")
  -param key=value
        extra raw API query parameter key=value (repeatable)
  -past
        only bookings that checked in before today
  -property TEXT
        property name contains TEXT
  -property-exact NAME
        property name is exactly NAME
  -source string
        booking source, e.g. Airbnb, Booking.com, "Direct booking"
  -status string
        filter by status: complete, id-verification-failed, incomplete, keys-error, keys-generated, keys-pending, police-check-in-error, police-check-out-error, stats-error, unpaid
  -to DATE
        check-in on or before DATE
  -upcoming
        only bookings checking in today or later
```

## `chekin bookings get`

```text
Usage: chekin bookings get ID [-o table|json]

Flags:
  -o string
        output format: table or json (default "table")
```

## `chekin version`

Prints `chekin` and the version. `--version` does the same. Builds that don't set a version at build time (including `go install` and `go build`) print `chekin dev`.
